name: SVB Collapse Scenario
description: Simulates the March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse and regional banking contagion

trigger.event: Regional bank experiences rapid deposit outflows and forced asset sales

contagion_pathway: → TFC, FITB, USB (regional bank contagion via shared depositor base)
→ BAC, WFC (large bank contagion via market confidence)
→ HYG (credit spread widening across financial sector)
→ SPY (broad market selloff on systemic risk fears)
key_indicators: Deposit flight accelerating across regional banks
Credit default swap spreads widening for financial sector
Flight to quality: Treasury rally, gold up
